key.pipcam.pin_here: Pin PiP camera at my view
pipcam.menu.title: PiP Camera
pipcam.status.no_world: Join a world to place or manage cameras
pipcam.status.unpinned: No camera placed yet — click "Place camera…"
pipcam.views.name: View name
pipcam.opt.label: Label
pipcam.tip.place: Fly the camera to where you want it. Your character stays put.
pipcam.tip.pin_here: Put the camera exactly where you are looking from right now.
pipcam.tip.save_new: Save the current camera as a new view.
pipcam.tip.rename: Rename the selected view without changing its saved position.
pipcam.tip.update: Overwrite the selected view with the current camera position and name.
pipcam.tip.track_player: Keep the camera pinned in place, but automatically aim it at your character.
pipcam.tip.move_hud: Drag the PiP window anywhere on screen, resize it, or snap it to a corner.
pipcam.tip.resolution: Internal resolution of the PiP picture. Higher is sharper but slower.
pipcam.tip.lighting: Auto follows world time; Day/Night override PiP lighting only.
pipcam.tip.weather: Draw rain and snow inside the PiP window.
pipcam.tip.dh_on: Draw Distant Horizons terrain in the PiP beyond normal chunks.
pipcam.tip.retain: Keep chunks around the camera visible when you walk away (frozen until you return).
pipcam.place.title: Place PiP camera
pipcam.place.hint_move: Move with movement keys  ·  Jump / Sneak = up / down  ·  Sprint = faster
pipcam.place.hint_look: Click picture to lock mouse (or hold Right-Click)  ·  Scroll = speed  ·  Ctrl+Scroll = FOV
pipcam.place.hint_locked: Mouse locked: move to look  ·  Click or Esc to release  ·  Scroll = speed
pipcam.hud_drag.title: Move PiP HUD
pipcam.hud_drag.hint: Drag the PiP window to move it  ·  Scroll to resize (%s%%)  ·  Esc when done
pipcam.msg.no_views: No saved PiP views yet (save one in the PiP menu)
